Sections.SectionDescription: Pick the body shape for your currently controlled character. Armor and clothing are refitted automatically; the choice is stored per character in your savegame.

Settings.Name: Body shape
Settings.Description: Applies immediately to your currently controlled character when changed (same effect as the !cm_setbody console command). Switch characters and change it again to set other party members.

Settings.Name: Re-apply on save load
Settings.Description: If enabled, the body shape above is re-applied to your controlled character every time a save finishes loading. Leave OFF to let each save keep its own per-character choices.

Settings.Name: Enable body and clothing management
Settings.Description: Ordinary master control. Turning this OFF restores tracked characters independently and blocks new Runtime writes. This is not cleanup, is not an uninstall procedure, and never makes a save tombstone-ready.

Settings.Name: SBBF/BCB body tattoos
Settings.Description: Controls naked SBBF/BCB bodies for the supported HUM_F family. It leaves Vanilla and your saved tattoo choice untouched. Match Vanilla is the default.

Sections.SectionDescription: Optional hotkeys. They act on your currently controlled character, exactly like the Body shape picker above. All are UNBOUND by default - assign a key here if you want them.

Settings.Name: Cycle body (Vanilla > SBBF > BCB)
Settings.Description: Cycles the controlled character's body shape: Vanilla -> SBBF -> BCB -> Vanilla.

Settings.Name: Set body: Vanilla
Settings.Description: Sets the controlled character's body to Vanilla.

Settings.Name: Set body: SBBF
Settings.Description: Sets the controlled character's body to SBBF.

Settings.Name: Set body: BCB
Settings.Description: Sets the controlled character's body to BCB.
